open.description: The controlled open state of the collapsible.

default-open.description:
The initial open state of the collapsible when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the collapsible.

collapsed-height.description: The height of the content when collapsed.

collapsed-width.description: The width of the content when collapsed.

as-child.description: Apply the props to the first child element instead of this element.

debug.description: Log state transitions, events and prop changes to the console. Applies to descendants too.

openchange.description: Fired when the open state changes.

exitcomplete.description: Fired when the exit animation completes.

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the collapsible. Useful for composition.
